ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; the surface is dominated by low-intensity black pixels with minimal high-intensity white pixel coverage limited to the distal tips and faint surface spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation across both lobes; distinct high-contrast contiguous clusters of light-colored pixels (beige/white) concentrated at the extreme lateral tips (coordinates approximately 5%, 5% and 95%, 5% of the visible fluke width).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression at the central midline; approximately 40-50 degree internal angle with significant pixel depth relative to the lobe heights.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire superior trailing edge; peaks and valleys ranging from 2-10 pixels in amplitude relative to the local edge mean.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature originating from the median notch, reaching a maximum height mid-lobe before tapering to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-contrast pixel clusters (barnacles) at the lateral tips; secondary faint, low-contrast circular outlines (scar rings) distributed across the dark ventral surface area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the distal tips of both lobes, creating an irregular, encrusted topographic boundary.
